observed: Result: Passed, on the QA lead's ruling of 12 Oct 2026.
What the requirement asks: the work order number, unit number and status are always on the card and can't be turned off.
In Board View > Fields to display, these three are not in the list at all, so there is no way to turn them off.
With every other field turned off, the card still showed the work order number (S10043-17989), the status (Approved) and the unit (TRK-118).
Small difference, accepted: the test expected the menu to list the three as locked 'always on' fields; the menu leaves them out instead.

What the test protects: once a lead change is refused, none of the other changes made in the same save go through.
This build has no single edit window that saves the lead, mileage, engine hours and PO together.
On an invoiced work order, the Lead Technician, Mileage and Engine Hours can't be changed at all; after a reload they still read Esther Howard, 123,456 and 3,420.
The Customer PO on the Finance tab is saved on its own (a separate save), so it isn't 'another edit in the same save'.
So nothing the test protects can change once the work order is invoiced.
